entries.title: Cyrus.
entries.content:
Cyrus. The son of Astyages and Esther. See App-57 , on the genealogy of the Persian kings. So named Neh 200 years before he was born (Isaiah 44:28 ). The book of Esther precedes the book of Ezra-Nehemiah, and Nehemiah 1:1 Nehemiah 7:4 precedes Ezr 1:1-14 . See note on Nehemiah 1:2 .Esther 3:8 ; Esther 10:3 , and App-57 .

the LORD. Hebrew. Jehovah. App-4 .

mouth . Compare 2 Chronicles 36:21-23 .Jeremiah 29:10-14 .

spirit. Hebrew. ruach. App-9 .

entries.title: God.
entries.content:
God. Hebrew. Elohim. App-4 .

God of heaven. See note on 2 Chronicles 36:23 . Appropriate in the mouth of Cyrus, and in contrast with all heathen inscriptions.

hath given me. The son of Astyages (the venerable king = Ahasuerus) and Esther. Trained by Mordecai and Nehemiah, he was brought up in the knowledge of God and His Word.

charged me to build. Compare Isaiah 44:24-28 ; Isaiah 45:1-6 , Isaiah 45:13 .

an house. This proclamation put first, as it is the great subject treated of by Ezra.

entries.title: Who is there . . . ?
entries.content:
Who is there . . . ? Figure of speech Erotesis. App-6 .

build = rebuild.

entries.title: whosoever
entries.content:
whosoever [of the captive people] remameth in any place, &c. Note the Figure of speech Ellipsis.

remaineth = is left.

the men of his place: i.e. his Persian neighbours.

God. Hebrew. Elohim. (with Art.) = the [true] God, App-4 .

entries.title: the chief of the fathers:
entries.content:
the chief of the fathers: i.e. those named in the next chapter.

chief = heads.

judah and Benjamin. But the other tribes found representatives. Compare Ezra 2:59 , Ezra 2:70 , where the terms "of Israel" and "all Israel" are used. In 1 Chronicles 9:3 , Ephrairn and Manasseh are mentioned by name. See note on 1 Kings 12:17 .

entries.title: their hands
entries.content: their hands = them. Put by Figure of speech Synecdoche (of Part), for themselves.

entries.title: which Nebuchadnezzar had brought.
entries.content: which Nebuchadnezzar had brought. Compare 2 Kings 24:13 ; Ezr 25:14 . 2 Chronicles 36:1 .Jeremiah 27:18-22 ; Jeremiah 28:6 ; Jeremiah 52:18 , Jeremiah 52:19 . Daniel 1:2 ; Daniel 5:2 .

entries.title: Sheshbazzar
entries.content: Sheshbazzar = the Chaldean name of the prince of Judah. Not Zerubbabel, which means born at Babel. Probably = Nehemiah, for he was the son of Hachaliah and Zidkijah (Nehemiah 10:1 ), and therefore a "prince of. Judah".

entries.title: chargers
entries.content: chargers = basons or bowls. Hebrew. 'agartal. In Numbers Ke'arah, plate or dish. Eng. "charger", from French charger, to load. Hence used of both a dish and a horse.

entries.title: these are.
entries.content:
these are. This chapter is parallel with Nehemiah 7:69 . See the Structure, p. 617, and App-58 .

children = sons.

the Province: i.e. the Persian province of Judah. Compare Nehemiah 1:3 .

and Judah. Some codices read "and unto Judsea". Compare Nehemiah 7:6 .

one. Hebrew ' Ish . App-14 .

entries.title: came with Zerubbabel.
entries.content:
came with Zerubbabel. But not till after Nehemiah 1:1 Nehemiah 7:4 . See note on Nehemiah 1:2 , Nehemiah 1:3 . In Nehemiah 7:4 no houses built, but in Haggai 1:4 , houses built and yet Temple lying waste.

Jeshua. The great helper of Zerubbabel. Nehemiah. Compare Nehemiah 1:1 ; Nehemiah 10:1 . See note on "Shesh-bazzar", Ezra 1:8 .

Seraiah = Azariah (Nehemiah 7:7 ). Not Seraiah the high priest, put to death with Zedekiah (2 Kings 25:18-21 ).

Mordecai. He had been taken in Jehoiachin's deportation (Esther 2:5 , Esther 2:6 ).

the People of Israel. See note on Ezra 1:5 . Son 2:59 , Son 2:70 ; Song of Solomon 3:1 ; Song of Solomon 7:13 ; Son 9:1 ; Son 10:5 . Compare 1 Kings 12:17 .

entries.title: Kirjath-arim.
entries.content: Kirjath-arim. Now Khan 'Er'ma. Some codices, with Septuagint and Vulgate, read "Kirjath-jearim".

entries.title: Jedaiah.
entries.content: Jedaiah. The head of the ninth course (1 Chronicles 24:11 ).

entries.title: Immer.
entries.content: Immer. The head of the sixteenth course (1 Chronicles 24:14 ).

entries.title: Pashur.
entries.content: Pashur. Compare Jeremiah 20:1 ; Jer 20:21 .Jeremiah 20:1; Jeremiah 20:1 and 1 Chronicles 9:12 . Probably belonging to the fifth course, as son of Malchijah. Compare 1 Chronicles 24:9 with Nehemiah 11:12 .

entries.title: Harim.
entries.content: Harim. The third course. These four were subdivided into six each, making the twenty-four.

entries.title: Nethinims
entries.content: Nethinims = men given to God or His service. Temple servants. Compare Ezra 2:58 ; Ezra 7:7 , Ezra 7:24 ; Ezra 8:17 , Ezra 8:20 . Nehemiah 3:26 ; Nehemiah 10:28 ; Nehemiah 11:21 . 1 Chronicles 9:2 .

entries.title: Shalmai.
entries.content: Shalmai. Some codices, with one early printed edition, Septuagint and Syriac, read "Selami".

entries.title: of Israel.
entries.content: of Israel. See note on Ezra 2:2 , and compare 1 Kings 12:17 .

entries.title: as polluted, put.
entries.content: as polluted, put. Revised Version = deemed polluted and put. Hebrew. gaal, to pollute; not ga'al, to redeem. Supply Ellipsis thus: "therefore were they [rejected] from the priesthood as polluted", So in Nehemiah 7:64 ; Nehemiah 13:29 . Isaiah 59:3 ; Isaiah 63:3 .Lamentations 4:14 .Zephaniah 3:1 . Mai. Ezra 1:7 .

entries.title: Tirshatha
entries.content:
Tirshatha = governor (Persian title). Here refers to Nehemiah, as in Nehemiah 8:9 ; Nehemiah 10:1 ; Nehemiah 12:26 . The Hebrew title is Pechah (Nehemiah 5:14 , Nehemiah 5:18 ; Nehemiah 12:26 ). Whence the Turkish Pashah. See note on Ezra 5:3 .

not eat of the most holy things: i.e. the remains of the meal offering, sin offering, and right shoulder of the peace offerings. Compare Leviticus 2:3 ; Leviticus 10:12-14 , Leviticus 10:16 , Leviticus 10:17 . Numbers 18:9 , Numbers 18:10 .

holy. See note on Exodus 3:5 .

with = for. Urim and with Thummim. See note on Exodus 28:30 . Numbers 26:55 .

entries.title: congregation
entries.content:
congregation = assembly, or muster.

forty and two thousand three hundred and threescore. This number (42,360) agrees with Nehemiah 7:66 . The two lists of names are not alike; but there is no "discrepancy". The two lists, while they agree in the numbers, and vary in names, yet have the totals identical. This shows the independence of the two accounts.

Numbered in Ezra 2 42,360

Named in Ezra 29,818

Named in Neh, not in Ezra 1,765 31,583

---------- ----------

Difference between names and numbers 10,777

Numbered in Nehemiah 7 42,360

Named in Nehemiah 31,089

Named in Neh, not in Ezra 494 31,583

---------- ----------

Difference between names and numbers 10,777

entries.title: maids
entries.content: maids = handmaids.

entries.title: some
entries.content:
some = a portion. Ezra mentions what one portion gave. Nehemiah ( Ezr 7:70 ) mentions what he and two other portions gave. Hence the numbers "perforce" cannot be the same, and there is no "discrepancy".

chief = heads.

the LORD. Hebrew. Jehovah.

God. Hebrew. Elohim. (with Art.) = the [true] God. App-4 .

entries.title: treasure
entries.content: treasure = treasury.

entries.title: all Israel.
entries.content: all Israel. See note on Ezra 2:2 , and 1 Kings 12:17 .

entries.title: seventh month.
entries.content:
seventh month. Tisri. See App-51 .

children = sons.

of Israel. See note on Ezra 2:2 , and 1 Kings 12:17 .

the cities. Some codices, with Septuagint, Syriac, and Vulg, read "their cities".

to = in. Therefore this was after Nehemiah 7:1-4 .

entries.title: Jeshua
entries.content:
Jeshua . The high priest. Spelled Joshua in Haggai 1:1 ; Haggai 2:2 .Zechariah 3:1 .

Jozadak. The son of Seraiah (1 Chronicles 6:14 , 1 Chronicles 6:15 ). But Ezra was the son of Seraiah (Ezra 7:1 ). Therefore Ezra was brother to Jozadak and uncle to Joshua the high priest.

Zerubbabel. Compare Matthew 1:12 .Luke 3:27 , called Zorobabel.

God. Hebrew. Elohim. (with Art.) = the [true] God. App-4 .

offer = offer up. Hebrew. 'alah . App-43 .

written in the law of Moses. See note on Exodus 17:14 , and App-47 .

the man Of God (with Art.) = the [true] God. See note on Deuteronomy 33:1 ; and App-49 .

entries.title: people
entries.content:
people = peoples.

the LORD. Hebrew. Jehovah. App-4 .

entries.title: kept, &c.
entries.content:
kept, &c. As recorded also in the parallel passage (Nehemiah 8:1-18 ).

as it is written. See Leviticus 23:34-43 .Deuteronomy 16:13-15 , and compare 1 Kings 8:2 , 1 Kings 8:65 .

entries.title: and.
entries.content:
and. Note the Figure of speech Polysyndeton ( App-6 ), to emphasize each detail.

carpenters = artificers.

bring cedar trees. Compare 1 Kings 5:6 . 2Ch 2:8 , 2 Chronicles 2:10 .

Joppa. Compare Joshua 19:46 . Acts 9:35 , 3 John 1:3; 3 John 1:3 .

grant. Occurs only here.

Of = from. Genitive of Origin. See App-17 .

entries.title: God.
entries.content: God. Hebrew. Elohim. (with Art.) the [true] God. App-4 . set forward = oversee.

entries.title: Judah:
entries.content: Judah: or Hodaviah, as in Ezra 2:40 .

entries.title: they set the priests:
entries.content:
they set the priests: or, the priests took their stand.

cymbals. Hebrew mziltayim. Dual form, meaning two metal discs struck together, making a clashing sound. Not zilzilim, which = timbrels, but is translated cymbals in 2 Samuel 6:5 and Psalms 150:5 , from the rustling sound. See note on 1 Chronicles 13:8 .

entries.title: mercy
entries.content:
mercy = lovingkindness, or grace.

shouted with a great shout. Figure of speech Polyptoton. App-6 .

entries.title: chief
entries.content:
chief = heads.

who were. Some codices, with one early printed edition and "Vulgate, read "and the".

shouted aloud for joy. Thus fulfilling Jeremiah 33:10 , Jeremiah 33:11 .

entries.title: adversaries.
entries.content:
adversaries. The Samaritans (Ezra 4:10 ). See note on 2 Kings 17:24 , 2 Kings 17:26 .

children = sons.

the temple. The walls and gates already built by Nehemiah. See Structures (pp. 616, 617), and notes on Neh 1:21 , Jeremiah 25:11 . See special note at end of 2 Chronicles 36:21 .

the LORD. Hebrew. Jehovah. App-4 .

God. Hebrew. Elohim. App-4 .

entries.title: Zerubbabel.
entries.content:
Zerubbabel. See note on Ezra 3:2 .

chief = heads.

we seek your God. A priest had been sent to these Samaritans (2 Kings 17:28-33 ).

we do sacrifice unto Him. Hebrew text = "although we have not been sacrificing". Some codices, and two early printed editions, with Septuagint and Syriac, add "unto Him".

Esar-haddon. The son and successor of Sennacherib (see notes on 2 Kings 19:37 , and 2 Chronicles 33:11 ).

Assur = Assyria.

entries.title: Jeshua.
entries.content:
Jeshua. See note on Ezra 3:2 .

Israel. See note on Ezra 2:2 and 1 Kings 12:17 .

as = according as.

entries.title: troubled them in
entries.content: troubled them in = terrified them from.

entries.title: Cyrus.
entries.content:
Cyrus. The son of Astyages and Esther. See App-57 .

Darius: i.e. Darius Hystaspis (see App-57 , App-58 ). "Darius" being only an appellative (= the maintainer), needs "Hystaspis" to be added, to identify him; as Astyages, when called Darius, needs the addition of "the Mede". See App-58 , and notes on p. 618.

entries.title: Ahasuerus
entries.content: Ahasuerus = the venerable king. See App-57 , and p. 618. An appellative, used here of Cyrus (Ezra 4:5 ), or retrospectively of Astyages; or, this verse may he retrospective, and should he in parenthesis.

entries.title: Artaxerxes
entries.content:
Artaxerxes = the great king. Used here of the Cyrus of Ezra 4:3 . See App-57 , and p. 618. Ezra 4:7-23 may also be retrospective of Nehemiah 2:20 Nehemiah 6:5 ,

companions = colleagues or associates.

the Syrian tongue: i.e. in Aramaic characters as well as in the Aramaic language. Compare Esther 1:22 ; Esther 8:9 , where "writing" (Hebrew. kathab, to grave) is the same word as in this book.

entries.title: Rehum.
entries.content:
Rehum. From here to Ezra 6:18 is in Syriac, which was like the French of today. Compare 2 Kings 18:26 . From Ezra 6:19 -- Ezra 7:11 is Hebrew; and Syriac again from Ezra 7:12-27 ; then Hebrew.

the chancellor = the master of judgments or decrees.

the scribe: or secretary.

in this sort = after this manner.

entries.title: Dinaites.
entries.content:
Dinaites. Probably from a Persian city. Apharsathchites. A Medo-Persian tribe.

Tarpelites. Probably from east of Elymais.

Apharsites. Of Persian origin.

Archevites. From Babylonia. Compare Genesis 10:10 .

Susanchites. From the Persian province or city of Shushan, the capital of Elam.

Dehavites = the Dahae of Herodotus (i. 125).

Elamites. From a province of Persia.

entries.title: nations
entries.content:
nations = peoples.

Asnapper = Assur-bani-pal, or Sardanapalus, the only Assyrian king who got into Elam, or held Shushan (now Susa) its capital.

on this side = beyond, on the west side: regarded from the east side of the Euphrates.

at such a time. This may refer to the date of the letter; or be rendered, as in Revised Version, "and so forth".

entries.title: men.
entries.content: men. Chaldee. 'enosh. See App-14 .

entries.title: Jews.
entries.content:
Jews. Nehemiah, Hanani, and friends. Occurs eight times in Ezra, viz. Ezra 4:12 , Ezra 4:23 ; Ezra 5:1 , Ezra 5:5 ; Ezra 6:7 , Ezra 6:7 , Ezra 6:8 , Ezra 6:14 . The name by which they were known to Gentiles, because the majority belonged to Judah.

set up the walls. Quite true; for Nehemiah's work had long preceded this. And note that, when Nehemiah's work was done (Ezra 7:4 ) and the houses built, the house of God was still lying waste (Haggai 1:1-4 ). The Temple not mentioned here.

entries.title: we have maintenance
entries.content: we have maintenance = the salt of the palace is our salt. See note on Numbers 18:19 .

entries.title: answer.
entries.content: answer. Chaldee. pithgam = an order or decree. A Persian word. Occurs only here and Ezra 5:5 , Ezra 5:11 ; Ezra 6:11 .Daniel 3:16 ; Daniel 4:17 .

entries.title: I commanded
entries.content:
I commanded = I made a decree.

made insurrection. Chaldee lifted itself up.

entries.title: mighty kings.
entries.content: mighty kings. Such as David and Solomon.

entries.title: commandment
entries.content: commandment = decree.

entries.title: by force.
entries.content: by force. Chaldee by arm; "arm" being put by Figure of speech Metonymy (of Cause), App-6 , for the force put forth by it.

entries.title: GOD.
entries.content: GOD. Chaldee. 'elaha' (ha, emphatic), singular, same as Hebrew Eloah. App-4 .

entries.title: Haggai.
entries.content:
Haggai. The prophet of that name. In the second year of Darius (Haggai 1:1 ), "sixth month".

Zechariah. The prophet of that name. In the second year of Darius, "eighth month" (Zechariah 1:1 ).

GOD. Chaldee. 'elah (sing). Same as Eloah. App-4 .

of Israel. Still "Israel", because representative of the whole nation. See note on 1 Kings 12:17 .

even unto them: or "[which was] over them".

entries.title: governor.
entries.content:
governor. Chaldee. pechah (modern "Pasha"). Tatnai was governor in Syria, Zerubbabel was governor in Judah. Compare verses: Ezra 5:6 , Ezra 5:14 , Ezra 5:6 , Ezra 7:13 ; Ezra 8:36 . Daniel 3:2 , Daniel 3:3 , Daniel 3:27 ; Daniel 6:7 ; and Haggai 1:1 , Haggai 1:14 ; Haggai 2:2 , Haggai 2:21 .

companions = colleagues or associates.

commanded you = made a decree to you; given a firman.

make up = build. So the wall had already been built by Nehemiah. See the Chronological Structure, p. 617, and notes on p. 618; and App-58 .

entries.title: said
entries.content:
said = told. Chaldee. 'amar, which must be followed by the words spoken (which are given in next clause).

we. Note this pronoun (first person sing, and plural), Here, and Ezra 7:27 , Ezra 9:15 , and Nehemiah 1:1 Nehemiah 7:73 ; Nehemiah 12:27-43 ; Nehemiah 13:4-31 . Septuagint, Syriac, and Arab, read "they".

after this manner. Ezra 5:4 should be rendered "we told them what the names were, accordingly the names of the men", &c. It is not a question.

men. As in Ezra 4:21 .

make this building. Hebrew "build this building". Figure of speech Polyptoton ( App-6 ), for emphasis.

entries.title: the eye.
entries.content:
the eye. Figure of speech Anthropopatheia. App-6 . elders. Chaldee. sib = grey, hoary. Used only of Ezra here and Ezra 6:7 , Ezra 6:8 , Ezra 6:14 .

Darius. See note on Ezra 4:5 .

answer. See note on Ezra 4:17 .

entries.title: Tatnai.
entries.content:
Tatnai. His name has been recently found in a contract.

Apharsachites. See note on Ezra 4:9 .

entries.title: province.
entries.content:
province. Compare Nehemiah 1:3 .

great = rolling: i.e. too heavy to be moved without rolling.

entries.title: chief
entries.content: chief = head.

entries.title: the GOD of heaven.
entries.content:
the GOD of heaven. See note on 2 Chronicles 36:23 . GOD. Chaldee. 'elah. Same as Eloah. App-4 .

these many years ago. Neh 500 years.

and set up. Compare 1 Kings 6:1 .

entries.title: gave them.
entries.content: gave them. Compare 2 Kings 24:2 ; 2 Kings 25:8-11 .

entries.title: Cyrus.
entries.content:
Cyrus. Compare Ezra 1:1 .

Babylon. Included now with Persia. Compare Ezra 6:1 .Nehemiah 13:6 .

entries.title: the vessels.
entries.content:
the vessels. Compare Ezra 1:7 , Ezra 1:8 ; Ezra 6:5 .

Sheshbazzar. See note on Ezra 1:8 . This was Nehemiah, who was present, though the stone was actually laid by Zeruhbabel (Zechariah 4:9 ).

entries.title: carry them into
entries.content:
carry them into = set them down, or deposit them in.

is = is to be.

entries.title: Darius:
entries.content:
Darius: i.e. Darius (Hystaspis). See Chronological Structure and notes (pp 617, 618), and App-67 .

Babylon. See note on Ezra 5:13 .

entries.title: Achmetha
entries.content: Achmetha = Ecbatana, the capital of ancient Media.

entries.title: first. year of Cyrus.
entries.content:
first. year of Cyrus. Compare Ezra 1:1 .

offered. Chaldee. deba'h. Same as Hebrew. zebach. App-43 .

entries.title: rows
entries.content:
rows = layers or stories, as in 1 Kings 6:36 .

new timber. Should be "timber, one": i.e. one row. In changing the ancient characters into the modern square characters the aleph ('a) in had'a ("one"), in the ancient character, was mistaken for, Tau, the "th" in hadath ("new"), and so was transliterated. The Septuagint has preserved the original reading, and the Revised Version notes it in the margin. The two lines should read: "layers of great stones, three; and a layer of timber, one".

house = treasury: "house" being put by Figure of speech Metonymy (of Adjunct), App-6 , for the treasures in it.

entries.title: vessels.
entries.content:
vessels. Compare Ezra 1:7 .

is = was.

entries.title: Tatnai, governor
entries.content:
Tatnai, governor = Tatnai, pasha. See notes on Ezra 5:3 , Ezra 5:6 .

companions = fellow-labourers or colleagues.

entries.title: Jews.
entries.content: Jews. See note on Ezra 4:12 .

entries.title: I make a decree.
entries.content: I make a decree. This was a new decree of Darius Hystaspis.

entries.title: GOD.
entries.content:
GOD. Chaldee. 'elah . (Singular) Same as Hebrew Eloah. App-4 .

GOD of heaven. See note on 2 Chronicles 36:23 .

wine = strong red wine. Hebrew. chemer. See App-27 .

entries.title: sweet savours.
entries.content: sweet savours. See note on Leviticus 1:9 .

entries.title: alter.
entries.content: alter. A similar strong threat in the inscription of Darius on the Behistun rock ( App-57 ). Compare Daniel 3:29 .

entries.title: alter.
entries.content: alter. Supply Figure of speech Ellipsis ( App-6 ): "alter [this decree]".

entries.title: commandment
entries.content:
commandment = decree.

Cyrus, and Darius, and Artaxerxes. Note the Figure of speech Polysyndeton, to mark the important fact that three kings, at various times, were concerned in the rebuilding of Jerusalem. The last named was the first in order. Darius was Darius Hystaspis, and Artaxerxes was Astyages (the father of Cyrus), the same as in Nehemiah 2:1 . See App-57 and App-58 ; and notes on p. 618.

entries.title: Adar
entries.content: Adar = the twelfth month. See App-51 .

entries.title: children
entries.content: children = sons.

entries.title: offered
entries.content:
offered = brought near. App-43 .

all Israel. See note on 1 Kings 12:17 . Note the number "twelve". App-10 .

entries.title: as it is written
entries.content:
as it is written = according to the writing.

the book of Moses: i.e. the Pentateuch. See App-47 .

entries.title: And, &c.
entries.content:
And, &c. Here recommences the Hebrew language. See note on Ezra 4:8 .

kept the passover. One of the ten so recorded. See note on Exodus 12:28 .

entries.title: heathen
entries.content:
heathen = nations.

the LORD. Hebrew. Jehovah. App-4 .

God. Hebrew. Elohim. App-4 .

entries.title: Artaxerxes
entries.content:
Artaxerxes = the great king: i.e. Darius (Hystaspis). See notes on p. 618. App-57 and App-58 .

Ezra. By this genealogy (verses: Ezra 7:1-5 ), compared with 1 Chronicles 6:15 , Ezra was brother to Jehozadak and uncle to the high priest Joshua. Ezra was deported with Zedekiah.

son = descendant.

Seraiah. Slain at Riblah (2 Kings 25:18-21 ).

entries.title: ready
entries.content:
ready = skilful.

the LORD. Hebrew. Jehovah. App-4 .

God. Hebrew. Elohim. App-4 .

entries.title: children
entries.content:
children = sons.

and. Note the Figure of speech Polysyndeton ( App-6 ) in this verse.

Nethinims. See note on Ezra 2:43 .

entries.title: fifth month.
entries.content: fifth month. Nisan (March-April). App-51 .

entries.title: the first day of the first month.
entries.content:
the first day of the first month. See note on Genesis 8:13 .

first month. Ab (July-August). App-51 .

entries.title: to teach in Israel.
entries.content:
to teach in Israel. This was the chief duty of priests. See note on Deuteronomy 33:10 .

Israel. Judah contained representatives of the whole Nation. See note on 1 Kings 12:7 .

entries.title: the scribe . . . a scribe
entries.content: the scribe . . . a scribe = a perfect scribe. Figure of speech Epizeuxis ( App-6 ).

entries.title: GOD
entries.content:
GOD Chaldee. 'eldh. Same as Hebrew Eloah. App-4 .

GOD of heaven. See note on 2 Chronicles 36:23 .

entries.title: decree.
entries.content: decree. This decree (verses: Ezra 7:12-26 ) is in Clialdee. not in Hebrew. An inscription found at Susa commences with the same words.

entries.title: seven counsellors.
entries.content: seven counsellors. Compare Esther 1:10 , Esther 1:14 .

entries.title: Israel.
entries.content: Israel. See note on 1 Kings 12:17 .

entries.title: meat offerings
entries.content: meat offerings = meal offerings. Hebrew gift offerings. App-43 .

entries.title: vessels.
entries.content: vessels. See note on Ezra 1:1 .

entries.title: bestow, bestow.
entries.content: bestow, bestow. Figure of speech Anadiplosis ( App-6 ), for emphasis.

entries.title: I, even I.
entries.content: I, even I. Figure of speech Epizeuxis , for emphasis.

entries.title: wine.
entries.content:
wine. Compare Ezra 6:9 . Hebrew. chemer. App-27 .

without prescribing how much = without measure.

entries.title: diligently
entries.content:
diligently = quickly, exactly. A Persian word, , adrazda Occurs only here.

Why . . . ? Figure of speech Erotesis. App-6 .

entries.title: GOD
entries.content: GOD Chaldee. 'elahah = Hebrew Eloah (emph.) See App-4 .

entries.title: to banishment:
entries.content: to banishment: or exclusion from the assembly. Chaldee = to rooting out. Occurs only here.

entries.title: Blessed, &c.
entries.content: Blessed, &c. These two verses (27, 28) resume the Hebrew language.

entries.title: mercy
entries.content:
mercy = lovingkindness, or grace.

mighty. Hebrew. gibbor. App-14 .

chief = heads.

entries.title: chief
entries.content:
chief = heads: i.e. heads of houses.

them that went up. Most of these names appear in Ezr 2 and Nehemiah 10 . The number is 1,496. If there were no women with them, this might be the cause of the "strange" marriages in Ezra 1 0 and Nehemiah 10 .

Artaxerxes: i.e. Darius (Hystaspis). See App-57 and App-58 .

entries.title: by genealogy
entries.content: by genealogy = a lineage.

entries.title: Pahath-moab.
entries.content: Pahath-moab. Compare Ezra 2:6 .

entries.title: sons of Shechaniah.
entries.content: sons of Shechaniah. Septuagint reads "sons of Zattu, Shechaniah".

entries.title: Of.
entries.content: Of. Some codices, with one early printed edition and Septuagint, read "And of".

entries.title: sons of Shelomith.
entries.content: sons of Shelomith. Septuagint reads "sons of Bani, Shelomith".

entries.title: ten.
entries.content: ten. Some codices, with Syriac, read "twenty".

entries.title: last.
entries.content:
last. In contrast with others.

these. The only case where there were three heads. In all other cases (except Ezra 8:14 , where there are two) only one head is mentioned.

entries.title: them.
entries.content: them. Hebrew text reads "him"; but some codices, with one early printed edition, read "them", as in Authorized Version.

entries.title: together
entries.content:
together = out.

Ahava. Ahava. The name of the river, and of the city. Compare Ezra 8:21 .

abode = encamped.

none of the sons of Levi. Only priests and laymen. The Levites were slack. Compare Ezra 2:40 . Only a small number accompanied Zerubbabel (Ezra 2:36 ). Not so the priests (Ezra 2:36-39 ).

entries.title: for.
entries.content:
for. The Syriac and Vulgate omit the word "for" throughout this verse, and read "then sent I Eliezer", &c, as in Ezra 8:17 .

chief men = heads.

men of understanding. Figure of speech Antimereia (of Noun), App-6 = wise and prudent men, especially for teaching.

entries.title: Casiphia.
entries.content:
Casiphia. Not identified. Probably near Babylon.

Nethinims. These were the ministers of the Levites. Originally Gibeonites. See note on Ezra 2:43 .

entries.title: chief
entries.content: chief = princes.

entries.title: offering
entries.content:
offering = heave offering. App-43 .

all Israel. See note on Ezra 2:2 and 1 Kings 12:17 .

entries.title: basons
entries.content:
basons = bowls.

of = valued at.

fine copper, &c. = copper shining like gold.

entries.title: holy
entries.content: holy = a holy body. See note on Exodus 3:5 .

entries.title: By number and by weight of every one:
entries.content: By number and by weight of every one: or, the whole by number and weight.

entries.title: Also, &c.
entries.content:
Also, &c. The fourth of the ten Sedarim (or cycles for public reading) begins here and goes on to Nehemiah 2:10 , where it ends; thus uniting the two books in one. See note, p. 632.

children = sons.

entries.title: commissions
entries.content: commissions = Royal decrees. Hebrew. dath.

entries.title: the princes.
entries.content:
the princes. Not all of them. Compare Ezra 9:2 .

People of Israel. See note on Ezra 2:2 and 1 Kings 12:17 .

people = peoples, or nations.

Canaanites. Contrary to the law (Exodus 34:12-16 . Deuteronomy 7:1-3 ). See App-23 and App-25 .

entries.title: holy seed
entries.content:
holy seed , or the sanctuary's seed. See note on Exodus 3:5 and compare Daniel 2:43 .Exodus 19:6 ; Exodus 22:31 .Deuteronomy 7:6 ; Deuteronomy 14:2 .

trespass = defection. Hebrew. ma'al. App-44 . Not the same word as in Ezra 9:6 .

entries.title: rent my garment, &c.
entries.content:
rent my garment, &c. These were signs of inward mourning. See Ezra 9:5 . Jos 7:6 . 1 Samuel 4:12 . 2 Samuel 1:2 ; 2Sa 13:31 . 2 Kings 18:37 . Job 1:20 . Matthew 26:65 .

astonied: i.e. causing astonishment in such as saw me.

entries.title: trembled at the words, &c.
entries.content:
trembled at the words, &c. Compare Isaiah 66:2 .

transgression = defection. Hebrew. ma'al. App-44 .

sacrifice = meal offering. Hebrew. minchah. App-43 .

entries.title: having rent
entries.content:
having rent = having already rent.

I feel upon my knees. Compare Ezra 10:1 . 2 Chronicles 6:13 .Daniel 6:10 . Luke 22:41 .Acts 7:60 ; Acts 9:40 ; Acts 20:36 ; Act :21:5 .

the LORD. Hebrew Jehovah. App-4 .

entries.title: trespass.
entries.content: trespass. Hebrew. 'ashma (feminine.) = guilt incurred. The rnasc. = guilt imputed (as in Leviticus 5:7 . Numbers 5:8 . 2 Kings 12:16 . Psalms 68:21 ). App-44 . Not the same word as in Ezra 9:2 . Compare verses: Ezra 9:7 , Ezra 9:13 , Ezra 9:15 .

entries.title: been delivered.
entries.content: been delivered. For these selfsame sins! as in Ezra 9:2 . confusion of face. Compare Daniel 9:5-7 .

entries.title: a little space
entries.content:
a little space = a little while. Hebrew. kim'at. See note on "almost" (Proverbs 5:14 ). Referring to the respite which had been begun by the kings of Assyria (Ezra 6:22 .Nehemiah 9:32; Nehemiah 9:32 ) and continued by the kings of Persia.

remnant to escape. The same which Nehemiah had already inquired about (Nehemiah 1:2 , Nehemiah 1:3 ).

a nail = a peg surely driven in. Put by Figure of speech Metonymy (of Adjunct), App-6 , for the dwelling secured by it.

holy place = Jerusalem, or sanctuary. Compare Psalms 24:3 .Isaiah 56:7 , &c.

entries.title: we were.
entries.content:
we were. Or, supply the Ellipsis "we [are]".

bondmen. The subjects of the Persians (Nehemiah 9:36 ).

mercy = lovingkindness, or grace.

kings of Persia. See App-57 .

to repair the desolations. Compare Nehemiah 1:2 , Nehemiah 1:3 .

give us a wall. This helps to prove that the task of Nehemiah had already been effected. See the Structure on p. 617, notes on p. 618, and App-58 .

entries.title: what shall we say . . . ?
entries.content: what shall we say . . . ? Figure of speech Erotesis. App-6 .

entries.title: by
entries.content:
by = by the hand of.

filthiness. Showing Ezra's acquaintance with the Pentateuch. Compare Genesis 15:16 . Deuteronomy 9:5 .

entries.title: nor seek their peace.
entries.content:
nor seek their peace. Reference to Pentateuch: the very words of Deuteronomy 23:6 .

children = sons.

entries.title: evil.
entries.content:
evil. Heb, ra'a'. App-44 .

such deliverance: or, such a reserved survival.

entries.title: Should we . . . ?
entries.content: Should we . . . ? Figure of speech Erotesis.

entries.title: we remain yet escaped:
entries.content:
we remain yet escaped: or, we are left but a remnant that is escaped. Compare Nehemiah 1:2 , Nehemiah 1:3 .

behold. Figure of speech Asterismos. App-6 .

entries.title: when Ezra had prayed.
entries.content:
when Ezra had prayed. Note the change to the third person. This does not imply another authorship. Such changes are common. Compare Isaiah 6:5-8 ; Isaiah 7:3 ; Isaiah 37:6 with other passages. Also Jeremiah 20:1-6 with Ezra 10:7 ; and Jeremiah 21:1 with Jeremiah 28:1 , Jeremiah 28:5 .

God. Hebrew. Elohim. (with Art.) = the [true] God. App-4 .

Israel. Compare Ezra 1:5 .Ezra 2:2 , Ezra 2:59 , Ezra 2:70 ; Ezra 6:21 ; Ezra 7:10 , Ezra 7:13 ; Ezra 8:25 ; Ezra 9:1 . See note on 1 Kings 12:17 .

congregation = assembly. Assembled 24th Tisri. Compare Nehemiah 9:3 .

children = little ones. Hebrew. yeled. Not the same word as in Ezra 10:7 .

wept very sore. Hebrew "wept a great weeping". Figure of speech Polyptoton. See note on Genesis 26:28 .

entries.title: the sons of Elam.
entries.content:
the sons of Elam. Compare Ezra 10:26 .

answered and said. A Hebrew idiom, by which the first verb "answered" must be rendered according to the context. Here = "confessed and said".

trespassed = acted treacherously. Hebrew. ma'al . App-44 .

people = peoples.

in = for.

entries.title: such as are born.
entries.content:
such as are born. It does not appear that Shechaniah's proposal was carried out. Compare verses: Ezra 10:11 , Ezra 10:14 .

counsel. See Psalms 33:11 ; Psalms 73:24 ; Psalms 106:13 .Proverbs 8:14 ; Proverbs 19:21 .Isaiah 46:10 , Isaiah 46:11 .

my LORD* = Jehovah. One of the 134 places where Jehovah was altered by the Sopherim to Adonay. See App-32 and App-4 .

tremble. Compare Ezra 9:4 .

according to the law. See Deuteronomy 24:1 , Deuteronomy 24:2 .

entries.title: Arise.
entries.content: Arise. It would seem that Ezra continued kneeling.

entries.title: the chief priests
entries.content:
the chief priests = the princes of the priests. Compare 2 Chronicles 36:14 .

the Levites. Some codices, with one early printed edition, read "and the Levites".

entries.title: Then Ezra rose up.
entries.content:
Then Ezra rose up. In response to Shechaniah.

Johanan. The son of Eliashib, the high priest who succeeded Joiakim, the successor of Jeshua (Nehemiah 12:10 , Nehemiah 12:23 ).

came thither. According to Syriac and Arabic = "lodged (or spent the night) there".

mourned. Compare the first occurance of Hebrew ' abal . Genesis 37:34 .

transgression = unfaithfulness. Hebrew. ma'al. App-44 . Compare Ezra 10:2 ; Ezra 10:10 .

entries.title: children
entries.content:
children = sons. Not. the same word as in Ezra 10:1 .

captivity = exile. As in verses: Ezra 10:6 , Ezra 10:8 , Ezra 10:16 ; Ezra 1:11 ; Ezra 2:1 ; Ezra 4:1 ; Ezra 6:19 , Ezra 6:20 , Ezra 6:21 ; Ezra 8:35 .

entries.title: forfeited
entries.content:
forfeited = devoted.

carried away = into captivity.

entries.title: Judah and Benjamin.
entries.content:
Judah and Benjamin. Yet spoken of as containing representatives of all Israel. See note on Ezra 10:1 .

ninth month. That is Chisleu (= Nov. -Dec), four months after Ezra's arrival (Ezra 7:8 ).

street = broad place.

entries.title: trespass.
entries.content: trespass. Hebrew. 'ashah. See note on Ezra 9:6 .

entries.title: the LORD.
entries.content: the LORD. Hebrew. Jehovah. App-4 .

entries.title: As thou hast said
entries.content: As thou hast said = according to thy words. Hebrew margin reads "word".

entries.title: a time of much rain
entries.content:
a time of much rain = the rainy season.

transgressed = rebelled. Hebrew. pasha'. App-44 .

entries.title: rulers
entries.content:
rulers = princes.

for. Hebrew. 'ad = "until", as in the previous clause. Translate and supply Figure of speech Ellipsis ( App-6 ) thus: "until the fierce wrath of our God be turned from us, until this matter [be carried out]".

entries.title: Only
entries.content:
Only = But, or. Nevertheless.

Tikvah. Compare 2 Kings 22:14 and 1Ch 34:22 .

were employed, &c. = superintended [the business].

entries.title: certain
entries.content:
certain = men. Hebrew. 'enosh. App-14 .

chief = heads.

entries.title: the first day of the first month.
entries.content: the first day of the first month. See note on Genesis 8:13 . Ezra's last date. The commission, therefore, sat for eighty-eight days.

entries.title: the sons Of Joshua.
entries.content: the sons Of Joshua. Who had come up with Zerubbabel (Ezra 2:2 ). There were 973 priests of that house (Ezra 2:36 ). There were found guilty seventeen priests, ten Levites singers and sorters, and eighty-six lay people, making 118 in all.

entries.title: gave their hands.
entries.content:
gave their hands. Hebrew idiom for giving their word. Compare 2 Kings 10:15 .

being guilty. Compare Leviticus 5:1 .

a ram. See Leviticus 5:14-19 .

entries.title: Nethaneel.
entries.content: Nethaneel. Some codices, with five early printed editions, read "and Nethaneel".

entries.title: and Bamoth.
entries.content: and Bamoth. Hebrew text reads "Jeremoth". Margin reads "and Ramoth".

entries.title: of.
entries.content: of. Some codices, with one early printed edition, Septuagint, Syriac, and Vulg, have this word "of" in the text.

entries.title: strange
entries.content:
strange = foreign.

Thus ends the first part of this book "Ezra-Nehemiah"; not abruptly; as it is followed by the second part, which is concerned mainly with the rebuilding of the city and the walls, instead of with the Temple. The incidents recorded in Nehemiah 1:1 Nehemiah 7:4 had taken place before the first return under Zerubbabel, See the Structures and notes on pp 617, 618, and App-58 . Compare also Nehemiah 7:4 with Haggai 1:1-4 .
